facts.quote: His Majesty’s Lord-Lieutenant of County Tyrone
facts.statement: The King appointed William James Baxter as His Majesty’s Lord-Lieutenant of County Tyrone.
Sir Robert William Lowry Scott retired as Lord-Lieutenant of County Tyrone on 17 June 2026.

facts.quote: served in the RUC/PSNI from 1973 until his retirement in 2003 when he held the rank of Superintendent
facts.statement: William James Baxter served in the RUC/PSNI from 1973 until his retirement in 2003, when he held the rank of Superintendent.

facts.quote: was District Commander in Omagh from 1997
facts.statement: William James Baxter was District Commander in Omagh from 1997.

facts.quote: including the day of the Omagh bombing in 1998
facts.statement: William James Baxter was District Commander in Omagh on the day of the Omagh bombing in 1998.

entities.name: Omagh Police District Voluntary Welfare Support Group

facts.quote: He has served as Chairperson of the Omagh Police District Voluntary Welfare Support Group
facts.statement: William James Baxter has served as Chairperson of the Omagh Police District Voluntary Welfare Support Group.

facts.quote: He served as Clerk of Kirk Session, Newtownstewart Presbyterian Church, for 26 years
facts.statement: William James Baxter served as Clerk of Kirk Session at Newtownstewart Presbyterian Church for 26 years.
William James Baxter was an Elder for 31 years.

facts.quote: Mr Baxter has served as Sheriff for County Tyrone in 2013
facts.statement: William James Baxter served as Sheriff for County Tyrone in 2013.

facts.quote: is President of the Royal British Legion in Newtownstewart
facts.statement: William James Baxter is President of the Royal British Legion in Newtownstewart.

facts.quote: He was awarded the RUC Service Medal
facts.statement: William James Baxter was awarded the RUC Service Medal, along with other medals including the Queen’s Police Medal.

facts.quote: Mr Baxter has served as Deputy Lieutenant of County Tyrone for 14 years
facts.statement: William James Baxter has served as Deputy Lieutenant of County Tyrone for 14 years.

facts.quote: He lives in County Tyrone with his wife, Pearl, and has two adult children and four grand-children.
facts.statement: William James Baxter lives in County Tyrone with his wife, Pearl, and has two adult children and four grandchildren.
